sourceWork: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance (2013), main-story continuity
accessLimit: Official manual opened. Secondary equipment descriptions were available through indexed search; direct Fandom requests refused access. No official animation frames or exact costume pixel evidence obtained.

identities.blade_wolf_mgr: Mechanical quadruped with actual saw held by articulated tail; natural chassis height preserved.
identities.jetstream_sam: Dark ponytail, human face, exosuit, cybernetic right arm, red Murasama and powered scabbard.
identities.armstrong_mgr: Final battle shirtless body, rectangular glasses, dark trousers and black nanomachine-hardened skin. Old clothed sprite is a counter-example.
identities.mistral_mgr: Attached Dwarf Gekko robot arms and physical L’Étranger polearm; no magnetic power. Exact fourteen auxiliary arms are not certified in every small cell.
identities.monsoon_mgr: Red helmet/visor, silver hair, segmented cyborg and Dystopia sai; inorganic metal debris under magnetism. Old Raiden-like sprite is a counter-example.

renderingLimits: Native generated artwork and authored choreography are adaptations, not official game frames.
Body ROI selection is a visual approximation. Same-source native ratios preserve actual crouches and quadruped proportions; different-density corrective sources use declared comparable pose bridges.
No gore or victim bodies; finales adapt the same permitted techniques without introducing executions.
